technical_and_design_decisions: Docker container configurations (U1, U2, U3) will utilize standardized Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, and environment variable bindings to support linking to external services like RabbitMQ, Redis, ZooKeeper, Hadoop, and MongoDB.
Service discovery (U2) will be implemented using standard container networking and registration mechanisms (e.g., Consul or ZooKeeper integration) passed via container runtime configurations.
CI image build (U3) will be integrated into the automated build toolchain (Maven/Gradle Docker plugin or pipeline script) to build, tag, and publish Docker images.
Deployment documentation for Mesos/Marathon (U4) will include cluster deployment topology, Marathon application definition JSON templates, resource allocation rules, and health checks.
Spring Boot upgrade evaluation (U5) will involve updating dependency versions in project files, running full test suites, identifying breaking changes, and resolving regressions.
RDBMS to HDFS partitioning strategy (U6) will enhance the existing batch ingestion module to support configurable partitioning columns and custom partitioner implementations.
HDFS Source Module (U7) will be built as a native Spring XD source module leveraging Spring Integration HDFS support.
Configurable commit-interval (U8) will be exposed via `servers.yml` and injected into the job launch context for all partitioned out-of-the-box (OOTB) batch jobs.
assumptions: Development and testing are performed by a single software engineer with access to appropriate build tools, JDK 17+, and containerized test environments.
Target external services (RabbitMQ, Redis, ZooKeeper, Hadoop, MongoDB) are available in a local or CI container environment for testing.
The existing CI pipeline infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) supports running Docker builds and pushing images to a registry.
Existing OOTB partitioned jobs share a standardized configuration pattern that allows binding values from `servers.yml` without redesigning core job infrastructure.

activities.activity_name: Docker XD Container External Service Binding (U1)
activities.activity_description: Define and test Docker environment variables, linking attributes, and configuration templates for connecting Spring XD containers to external services (RabbitMQ, Redis, ZooKeeper, Hadoop, MongoDB).

activities.activity_name: Service Discovery Integration for Docker Containers (U2)
activities.activity_description: Implement and verify container service discovery configuration patterns to enable XD process discovery and inter-container communication in clustered environments.
Configure CI build scripts/plugins to automatically assemble, test, and publish Docker images for Spring XD components.
Author recommendation guide and template deployment descriptors for running a Spring XD cluster on Apache Mesos using the Marathon framework.

activities.activity_name: Spring Boot Dependency Upgrade & Impact Evaluation (U5)
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Spring Boot dependencies, run regression test suites, analyze breaking changes, and apply required compatibility fixes.

activities.activity_name: RDBMS to HDFS Data Partitioning Strategy Option (U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop configurable data partitioning logic in the RDBMS-to-HDFS ingestion module to enable parallelized data extraction and loading.
Implement, unit test, and document a new HDFS source module to support reading and streaming data directly from the HDFS filesystem.
Add `commit-interval` configuration support to `servers.yml` and wire it into all OOTB partitioned batch job configurations.
Perform end-to-end validation of new features, container configurations, module pipelines, and configuration overrides.
